text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! Did ya need me for somethin'?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me, but I have a prior engagement. 
Can we talk later? Don't worry, it won't 
take long.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to talk about training, but... It 
seemed like it would be over quickly, so I 
decided to accompany her on her errand.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! That is an impressive amount of 
data. With this, it'll feel like having 
the strength of a hundred people!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's just some data I grabbed while out 
for a run. ...Hell if I know what you'd 
use that for, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's a girl who's always hatching 
'schemes.' I was just keeping an eye on 
her to make sure she didn't get into 
trouble, but...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I've been expecting you. I have 
prepared the item in question.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Master Journey! You have my 
gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's almost complete. See, once I drip 
the chemical solution onto that sphere—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh?! It's glowing—!! Splendid work, 
Tachyon-dono~~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No, no. I'll be getting a sweet deal out 
of it too, after all.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Kukuku... Gwah hah hah hah ha! Fufufu... 
Wah hah hah hah ha!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Wh-Wh-What's the matter, what happened!?
choice_data_list:
You're not thinking of doing something 
dangerous, are you!?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Here we are. Allow me to put your mind at 
ease, seeing as you're so worried I might 
cause trouble.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Well, well~, what do you think? Feel free 
to look through every corner of this shop!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that, I spotted something familiar 
on the wall. A glowing object. That was 
definitely—

Fufu. That's a custom-made light this 
little one gave me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction of the voice, I 
saw an Umamusume wearing rosemary earrings 
standing there. Her nametag read "Store 
Manager."
choice_data_list: A custom-made light... from No Reason?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed!! I heard that a black tea café was 
opening near the academy, so I made 
preparations.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"First, ask Shakur-dono about how the 
crowd around the shop changes... and then 
propose an opening time tailored to that!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I shall have Journey-dono arrange an 
aromatic fragrance that will not interfere 
with the scent of any black tea.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"And for Tachyon-dono, who loves black 
tea, a lantern to make enjoying tea even 
more delightful!"
choice_data_list:
I see... Did you really like black tea 
that much?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nay! 'Tis because it marks my elder 
sister's new beginning!
choice_data_list: Oh, big sis... Wait, big sis?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason's Sister
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, she's just a neighborhood big sis. 
We used to play tag together all the time 
back then.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Mm! I'm not "just" anything!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Super talented and super outstanding! 
Everyone's fighting to be her training 
partner! Not a day goes by without hearing 
her name back home—

text_block_list.name: Young No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Big sis! The person who just came by was a 
Trainer, wasn't it?! Saying 'Please enroll 
at our academy'—that's incredible!

text_block_list.name: No Reason's Sister
text_block_list.text:
"No, it starts from here. There are plenty 
of girls at Tracen Academy faster than me. 
But... I'll show them what I'm capable of 
in no time!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason's Sister
text_block_list.text:
...Or so I tried my best to do, but... due 
to an injury, it became difficult to keep 
running. Now, I'm walking a new path like 
this.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Well, you can leave the race to me! I'll 
be out there kicking butt and taking 
names!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
And that brings us to... How's it going? 
The black tea café! Now that it's open and 
all.

text_block_list.name: No Reason's Sister
text_block_list.text:
It's tough, I suppose. There's so much to 
think about when opening a business. You 
ended up helping me out, too. But—

text_block_list.name: No Reason's Sister
text_block_list.text: I'll show you my true power in no time!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Ah, I knew it—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Sister is sister, indeed!
choice_data_list: I want to help out, too!

Your older sister is really someone you 
look up to, huh.

Your older sister is really someone you 
look up to, isn't she.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Sister is sister, indeed!
choice_data_list: I want to help out, too!

Your older sister is really someone you 
look up to, huh.

Your older sister is really someone you 
look up to, isn't she.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"I knew you'd say that! I'm counting on 
you to hand out flyers to the Trainers!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I felt like I had fallen right into their 
trap in the end, but I thought to myself 
that every once in a while wasn't so bad.

text_block_list.name: No Reason's Sister
text_block_list.text:
Oh, same here! Seeing you run back home... 
made me realize I couldn't just stay the 
way I was!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Big sister! Don't say things that 
make me cry! Urghhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, their motivation for the upcoming 
races became stronger than ever.
